result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both guides quote the samples well, but only B gives every habit an explicit limit (one admission, at most one aside, no aside when the news is bad, blunt about the plant and not the person). A's limits are patchy, and its 'Honesty is the brand' line invites overdoing the admissions. Both rewrites drop 'this weekend' and add care advice and 'Closed Mondays', which the original didn't contain, though each flags the care line. B also explains why it left out an aside instead of inventing one. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A's guide gives every habit a quoted example, a 'we don't say' contrast and an explicit limit. B lists the habits well but rarely says where they stop. Both rewrites drop 'this weekend' and add care advice the owner never gave. B adds more of it and turns the 'low maintenance' filler into 'they're not fussy' instead of cutting it. A is also tighter; its one flaw is calling the owner 'she' without knowing their pronouns.
